// what it does

Everything a listener actually wants, nothing they didn't ask for.

01

Full 9:16 video canvas

Official music videos rendered edge-to-edge as the now-playing background — no letterboxing, no cropping compromises.

02

Gyroscopic album art

Cover art tilts in real 3D as you move your phone, rendered at 60fps without draining the battery.

03

Synced lyrics

Word-level lyric timing layered over the now-playing screen, dimmed until the line comes around.

04

Gapless pre-fetching

The next track resolves quietly in the background so switching songs never leaves a gap of silence.

05

Offline caching

Played video and audio are cached to app-private storage — replay anything without touching your data plan.

06

Playlist import

Mirror playlists in from Spotify or YouTube Music straight into local storage you actually control.

// under the hood

A real DSP studio, not a three-slider EQ.

Tune sound the way you'd tune a mix

VOID Studio runs a live spectrum analyzer alongside a 10-band parametric EQ, a Schroeder algorithmic reverb, and a soft-knee compressor with genre-tuned presets — flat, warm, vocals, bass boost, lo-fi, cave, mastered. Output can be routed stereo, mono, swapped, or isolated to a single channel.

Parametric EQ Reverb Compressor Live spectrum Stereo pan

// changelog

What's changed recently.

v0.1.9Sep 2026
  • Online playlists fixed — resolved a 404/prefix handling bug so playlists load live tracks and counts instantly.
  • Audio stutter fixed — re-architected the EQ, reverb, and compressor chain to remove on-thread allocations.
  • Video quality selector — added 1080p, 720p, 480p, and 360p options under Settings.
  • Pre-Android 12 blur fallback — prevents GPU rendering lag on older devices.
  • Queue deduplication — fixed a bug that duplicated the current track in the queue.
v0.1.8Sep 2026
  • Stability pass ahead of the 0.1.9 DSP rework.

// the developer

Built solo, after dark.

I'm Adresh — an independent Android developer. VOID is the tool I wanted and couldn't find: something that plays music without asking for an account, a subscription, or a reason to show me ads.

It's fully open source under GPL-3.0. If you can read Kotlin, you can read exactly what VOID does on your phone — nothing more.

// privacy policy

No data collection. None.

VOID does not collect, record, track, or sell any personal information, location data, or device identifiers. There are no third-party analytics SDKs and no advertising networks anywhere in the app.

Audio and video stream directly from your device to YouTube Music / InnerTube over encrypted HTTPS — nothing passes through a server VOID owns. Downloaded audio, video caches, and lyrics live in your phone's app-private storage; playlists and settings stay in a local database on your device.

VOID is licensed under GPL-3.0. The full source is public, so this policy is verifiable rather than a promise.
